name: Juexing Zhi Ke
source:
The story takes place in the age of magic.In this adventure, the player will take the protagonist's perspective as a necromancer to solve problems
You will meet with different characters, experience a relaxed routine, wander among the organizations, resolve all crises in your own way, and explore the truth of the continent.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在魔法时代，在这次冒险中，玩家将以死灵法师的主角视角解决问题
你将遇到不同的角色，体验轻松的日常，游走于组织之中，以自己的方式化解一切危机，探索大陆的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200250/]Steam[/url]]
